description: One-book checks for the small Indian directory families outside the earlier report. Visakhapatnam Public Library (vpl) has search and record interfaces. NIT Trichy (libsys) exposes only ISBN availability in the app, so the runner records it as unsupported for a catalog-origin pass. The 19 'catalog' entries and IIM Tiruchirappalli are link-only (no adapter) and are listed in the report rather than queried.
